vi_context: Bảng màu phổ biến gồm trắng ngà, kem, be, nâu nhạt, xanh sage, vàng nhạt, hồng bụi, xanh trời và các màu đất. sentence: Explore softer fashion aesthetic references when comparing nature-inspired looks, rather than identifying Cottagecore from pastel colors alone.
en_before: For a Japanese-fashion direction sharing nature imagery and soft layering, Mori Kei offers a useful comparison. It emphasizes relaxed forest-inspired layers, while Cottagecore more often emphasizes rural romantic references, floral dresses or a defined waist. These are overlapping tendencies rather than exclusive rules.
